📇 Individual 360° Profile Cards (All 21 Personnel)

Specific data-backed audits, strengths, vulnerabilities, and targeted 30-60-90 day performance roadmaps.

🏛️ Four Pillars of Team Transformation & Operations Scaling

Data-driven management interventions to eliminate bottlenecks, increase cross-functional capacity, and compress turnaround times.

1

Cross-Skilling & Eliminating Workflow Silos (PA ⇄ Claim)

Risk: Single-point bottlenecks during demand surges

The Diagnosis: Extreme specialization creates critical operational risk. Four key personnel have 0% cross-queue coverage: Vani (5,582 Preauths, 0 Claims), Neelima (5,128 Preauths, 0 Claims), Dr Angel (2,493 Claims, 0 Preauths), and Dr Varun (1,916 Preauths, 0 Claims).

Operational Impact: When discharge claims spike at month-end, the claims queue chokes while preauth specialists have excess bandwidth. Conversely, morning elective admission preauths backlog while claim executives wait for bill dispatches.

Action Playbook: Launch a mandatory 2-week cross-rotation. Pair Vani with Kavitha, and Neelima with Sirisha. Mandate an 80:20 queue split (80% primary track, 20% secondary cross-track) to unlock an instant 15% surge buffer.
2

Pre-Dispatch Quality Gate (Cutting 1,480 Resubmissions)

Opportunity: Reclaim 120+ hours of wasted technician rework

The Diagnosis: Over 1,480 cases were resubmitted due to initial portal rejections. The top 3 volume executives alone generated 781 resubmissions: Laxminarayana (307), Sirisha (262), and Chanikya (212). Sai Charan has a 6.2% rework rate.

Operational Impact: Every resubmitted case takes 2.2x the time of a first-pass submission (re-reading rejection query, obtaining missing records, re-uploading), creating artificial delay and dragging customer satisfaction.

Action Playbook: Establish a 5-point Pre-Dispatch Gate (Verification of Patient ID, Signature, Itemized Bill matching Package Master code, Discharge Summary ICD-10, Mandatory Lab Reports). Aim to reduce resubmissions by 50% within 45 days.
3

Query Macro Standardization & TPA Turnaround

Opportunity: Accelerate hospital payment releases by 40%

The Diagnosis: Claim Query resolution is heavily concentrated on Ch Praveen (515 queries solved), Sai Charan (242), and Sirisha (221). Because query replies are individually drafted, response times vary from 4 to 28 hours.

Operational Impact: Unanswered queries lock hospital funds and delay patient discharge settlement. Queries consume disproportionate cognitive bandwidth of senior executives.

Action Playbook: Deploy standardized canned macro response templates for the top 10 recurring queries (OT notes, post-op X-rays, implant invoice with sticker, daily doctor rounding charts). This cuts query drafting time by 60% and unlocks 2+ hours daily per executive.
4

Tiered Clinical Triage & High-End Scrutiny Balance

Opportunity: Prevent doctor decision fatigue & enhance denial recovery

The Diagnosis: Clinical Scrutiny demonstrates an uneven complexity burden. Dr Sunitha handles staggering volume (7,948 cases, 7,237 points), while Dr Chinju (636 HD cases) and Dr Pranay (344 HD cases) carry the bulk of complex high-dependency medical/surgical reviews.

Operational Impact: Senior doctors spend excessive time auditing routine, low-risk daycare packages (cataract, dialysis, colonoscopy), taking time away from high-stakes surgical claims and denial appeals where clinical expertise saves lakhs.

Action Playbook: Implement 2-Tier Clinical Triage: Tier 1 (Routine standard claims audited by newer doctors like Dr Varun & Dr Angel) and Tier 2 (Complex HD, ICU, high-cost implants audited by Dr Sunitha, Dr Bindu, Dr Chinju, Dr Pranay).
